content.description:
FILED AS A TASK BECAUSE CHARTER D520 MEASURED A 0% EXECUTION RATE FOR LEAD ACTS WRITTEN AS CHARTER PROSE. Charter D547, derived this wave against the tree rather than from a merge claim.

(1) CLOSE #10400 AS SUPERSEDED - DO NOT REBASE IT. Its head (9eca3657) defines 78 tests in deploy_ledger_test.exs against main's 93, and `comm -23` of the two sorted test-name sets is EMPTY: zero tests it has that main lacks. Its deploy_ledger_reachability_test.exs is an OLDER copy of main's (stale @publics_floor 16 / @call_sites_floor 14). Its deploy_ledger.ex is 688 lines BEHIND main - it is NOT byte-identical; that phrase describes #11368's rebase branch, not this PR. The content landed via #11368. Delete the stranded branch origin/loop-epic/the-content-api-s-own-status-stops-being-1 with it.

(2) KEEP #10129 PARKED. Charter D167 and D185 already ruled its rebase SEMANTIC, not mechanical - a ten-rung vs eight-rung attention ladder plus whether `unmetered` is a rung at all. Its real conflict set is SIX files (attention_order.json, cloud_status_cmd.go, cloud_status_cmd_test.go, attention_order_cases.json, internal/cloudclient/client.go, internal/semrole/semrole.go). Do not assign a builder; it waits on the owner's ladder ruling.

(3) MERGE-PATH #10811. Its real conflict set is only THREE files (payload_key_set_census_test.exs, cloud_deploy_census_cmd.go, cloud_deploy_census_cmd_test.go) and - refuting the inherited premise - internal/cloudclient/client.go merges CLEAN. It is the only Go reader for coalesced_attempts, which `git grep` proves absent from internal/ on main. Re-run `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head>` immediately before assigning, because client.go took five merges in two days.
